findings: 2026-11-06: drafted for Mathematics 12 Unit 6 (owner request): English and a teacher-style Roman Urdu lesson; the book's content in order with our clearly labelled teaching notes; worked examples step by step with reasons; results verified with sympy.

Book correction: In the book's Figure 6.16 (p. 192) the right focus is labelled F'(h + c, k); it is F(h + c, k). The centre is printed C'(h.k) and the top co-vertex B(h.k + b), with dots in place of commas; they are C(h, k) and B(h, k + b). The right vertex is labelled B(h + a, k); it is the vertex A(h + a, k). The number 6.16 is also used for the figure in 6.4.1. Our drawing shows the correct labels.
Book correction: The book's Figure 6.19 labels both foci with a prime: F'(-5, 0) and F'(5, 0). The right focus is F(5, 0). Our drawing shows the correct label.
